source_refs.note: Exercise 12.3, Question 1: limit of A(t) = A0 e^(-0.1t) as t -> infinity (book p.235). Answer key PDF 310: 0.

blocks.prompt: 1 A substance decays exponentially following the formula \(A(t) = A_0 e^{-0.1t}\), where \(A_0\) is the initial amount. Find the limit of \(A(t)\) as \(t \to \infty\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh real life ka limit at infinity wala sawal hai: ek radioactive cheez waqt ke saath kam hoti ja rahi hai (decay).
Humein batana hai ke bohat lamba waqt guzarne ke baad (\(t \to \infty\)) kitni cheez bachegi.
Power mein minus sign decay ki nishani hai.
Plan: \(e^{-0.1t}\) ko \(\frac{1}{e^{0.1t}}\) likhein, dekhein ke yeh 0 ki taraf jata hai, phir \(A_0\) se multiply karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A(t) = A_0 e^{-0.1t}\), jahan \(A_0\) shuru ki miqdaar (positive constant) hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim_{t \to \infty} A(t)\).
Tareeqa: Constant ko limit se bahar nikaal sakte hain; phir \(e^{-0.1t} \to 0\) istemal karenge.
Bunyadi baat: agar \(k\) positive constant ho to \(t \to \infty\) par \(e^{kt} \to \infty\), aur \(e^{-kt} = \dfrac{1}{e^{kt}} \to 0\). Yeh kitab ka "Important Result" hai: \(\lim_{x \to \infty} e^{x} = \infty\) aur \(\lim_{x \to -\infty} e^{x} = 0\). Wajah simple hai: \(e \approx 2.718\) ko baar baar khud se multiply karte jayein to number behad bara hota jata hai, aur us ka ulta (1 over) behad chhota.

Constant ko bahar nikalein
\[\lim_{t \to \infty} A(t) = A_0 \lim_{t \to \infty} e^{-0.1t}\]
Kyun: \(A_0\) waqt ke saath nahi badalta. Theorems on limits ke mutabiq constant \(\times\) function ki limit = constant \(\times\) function ki limit.

Exponential ki limit nikalein
\[e^{-0.1t} = \frac{1}{e^{0.1t}}\]
\[t \to \infty \Rightarrow e^{0.1t} \to \infty\]
\[\lim_{t \to \infty} e^{-0.1t} = 0\]
Kyun: Negative power ka matlab "1 over" hai. Neeche wala \(e^{0.1t}\) waqt ke saath behad bara hota jata hai, aur 1 ko bohat bare number se divide karein to jawab 0 ke qareeb aa jata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{-0.1t}\) kabhi bilkul 0 nahi banta, sirf 0 ke qareeb se qareeb tar hota hai. Limit yahi "qareeb hona" batati hai.

Dono ko jorein
\[\lim_{t \to \infty} A(t) = A_0 \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi number ko 0 se multiply karein to 0. Matlab: bohat lambe waqt ke baad cheez taqreeban khatam ho jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[t = 100:\ e^{-10} \approx 0.0000454\]
\[A(100) \approx 0.0000454\,A_0\]
Kyun: Sirf 100 saal baad hi shuru ki miqdaar ka bohat hi chhota hissa bachta hai. Yeh limit 0 ki tasdeeq hai.
